items.title:
com.telamin.fluxtion:fluxtion-builder-all-java8 1.0.3 发布, Self-contained Java 8 fat jar of fluxtion-builder + fluxtion-runtime + their
        transitive dependencies, post-processed with Retrolambda + RetroPatch so the
        bytecode loads cleanly in CheerpJ Java 8 mode (and any other Java-8-only JVM).

        Pulls fluxtion-runtime + fluxtion-builder normally, then swaps the default
        agrona 2.x transitive (class file 61, JDK 17+) for agrona 1.21.2 (class file
        52, Java 8). The runtime's bytecode references against agrona are
        binary-compatible across the two surfaces (verified 2026-05-14: 19 unique
        refs all resolve), so the swap is transparent.

        Primary consumer is the fluxtion-web playground (CheerpJ), but the artifact
        is published independently on Maven Central for any external Java 8 consumer
        that wants the entire build-and-run pipeline in one jar.

        After shade, a two-stage bytecode pipeline (com.telamin.fluxtion.web.buildtools)
        rewrites every invokedynamic + LambdaMetafactory call site to a real anonymous
        class file (Retrolambda) and injects writeReplace() into each generated
        Lambda$N (RetroPatch ASM pass). This works around CheerpJ Java 8 mode's
        failure to re-resolve invokedynamic in JAR-shipped classes on the second hit,
        plus Retrolambda issue #195 (no writeReplace synthesis for serializable
        lambdas) which would otherwise break Fluxtion's LambdaReflection introspection.
